record.reason: The primary source explicitly presents an intra-layer model-parallel method for training large Transformer models; experiments train models up to 8.3B parameters using 512 NVIDIA V100 GPUs (§1, §3-5). Its 15.1 PFLOP/s application throughput and 76% scaling efficiency describe distributed training. The conclusion's future work remains larger-scale pretraining and optimizer memory efficiency (§6). No inference-time efficiency method or evaluation is presented in the reviewed paper.
record.title: Megatron-LM: Training Multi-Billion Parameter Language Models Using Model Parallelism
